falseSynonyms.zh: 不是自然的 marketplace listing 同義詞 sales entry 更容易理解為銷售系統、帳簿或資料庫中的一筆銷售紀錄，而不是公開待售頁。
falseSynonyms.point: A listing advertises an item for sale; a sales entry normally records a sale or sales data.

falseSynonyms.zh: 已售紀錄不等於待售刊登 sales record 通常記錄已發生的交易、金額或歷史銷售資料。
falseSynonyms.point: The listing exists before the sale; the sales record is created after or during the transaction.

falseSynonyms.zh: 頁面不等於所有 listing product page 可以承載一個 listing，但某些 listing 只是搜尋結果條目、卡片或簡短貼文。
falseSynonyms.point: A product page may contain a listing, but a listing need not occupy a full page.

falseSynonyms.zh: 廣告很接近，但更偏宣傳 有些 listing 主要是結構化資訊，而不是廣告式文案。
falseSynonyms.point: A product listing may be factual and structured rather than promotional.

falseSynonyms.zh: 目錄條目不一定在出售 catalogue entry 可以只是記錄產品資訊，未必有價格或可購買狀態。
falseSynonyms.point: A museum catalogue entry is not a sales listing.

falseSynonyms.zh: 貼文範圍太廣 post 可以是社交媒體內容、論壇帖文、公告等，不一定涉及商品。
falseSynonyms.point: An item posting is a sales-related post; a post in general may have nothing to sell.

falseSynonyms.zh: 出價／優惠不等於 listing offer 可能是買家的出價，也可能是促銷優惠；listing 是公開刊登本身。
falseSynonyms.point: A buyer can make an offer on a listing.

falseSynonyms.zh: 庫存條目不等於公開刊登 inventory entry 是內部存貨記錄，可能從未公開給買家。
falseSynonyms.point: A store may have an inventory entry for an item that has no public listing.
